name: Tetrahydropalmatine
summary: Tetrahydropalmatine (THP) is an isoquinoline alkaloid found in several different plant species, mainly in the genus Corydalis (Yan Hu Suo), but also in other plants such as Stephania rotunda. These plants have traditional uses in Chinese herbal medicine.

pharmacology.text: The pharmacological profile of l-THP includes antagonism of dopamine D1, and D2 receptors as well as actions at dopamine D3, alpha adrenergic and serotonin receptors. The Ki values for l-THP at D1 and D2 dopamine receptors are approximately 124 nM (D1) and 388 nM (D2).

uses.text: The pharmaceutical industry has synthetically produced the more potent enantiomer Levo-tetrahydropalmatine (Levo-THP; technically l-THP, often written L-THP), which has been marketed worldwide under different brand names as an alternative to anxiolytic and sedative drugs of the benzodiazepine group and analgesics such as opiates. It is also sold as a dietary supplement.

sideEffects.text: In November 2013, the Chinese National Medical Products Administration issued an order asking for all medications containing l-THP to have their package inserts revised, prohibiting use in pregnant women and those with extrapyramidal disorders, requiring warnings about liver impairement and operation of machinery, and highlighting risks of drowsiness and extrapyramidal symptoms with overuse or when combined with other CNS depressants.

summaryZh: 延胡索乙素是一種異喹啉類生物鹼，主要存在於作為草藥的紫堇屬植物（延胡索）和千金藤屬植物中。製藥工業已合成出效力更強的對映異構體左旋延胡索乙素（羅通定、l-THP，也常誤寫作L-THP），作為抗焦慮藥和鎮靜劑如苯二氮䓬類藥物以及鎮痛藥如阿片劑的替代品在全球以不同品牌名銷售。它也作為營養補充品銷售。
summaryZhHans: 延胡索乙素是一种异喹啉类生物碱，主要存在于作为草药的紫堇属植物（延胡索）和千金藤属植物中。制药工业已合成出效力更强的对映异构体左旋延胡索乙素（罗通定、l-THP，也常误写作L-THP），作为抗焦虑药和镇静剂如苯二氮䓬类药物以及镇痛药如阿片剂的替代品在全球以不同品牌名销售。它也作为营养补充品销售。

fact.en: Tetrahydropalmatine comes mainly from the tubers of Corydalis, known as yan hu suo in Chinese medicine. In the 1990s, a herbal product containing it called Jin Bu Huan was linked to cases of liver damage in the United States.
fact.zh: 延胡索乙素主要來自延胡索屬植物的塊莖，在中醫裡稱為延胡索。1990年代，一款含有它的草藥產品「金不換」在美國與多起肝損傷病例有關。
fact.zhHans: 延胡索乙素主要来自延胡索属植物的块茎，在中医里称为延胡索。1990年代，一款含有它的草药产品「金不换」在美国与多起肝损伤病例有关。
